# Release 1.1.0 review

## Requirements and implementation

* Default runtime version is 1.1.0; Release, Debug/wrapper, package metadata,
  and extracted-package execution agree.
* README and release notes explicitly document removed double-dash
  concurrency options, changed model/effort defaults, aliases, CLI version
  resolution, and analytics changes.
* Release-close changes do not alter agent, verifier, scheduling, retry, or
  analytics behavior. Historical datasets remain unchanged.
* A release-blocking package defect was discovered by executing the artifact,
  documented before cleanup, and corrected with full publish-payload copying.
* Regression coverage proves a package can execute with a requested version
  different from the source default, rather than only testing file presence.
